info.title: Checkbox API
info.description:
Checkbox is compliance infrastructure for subscription businesses: it checks a sign-up flow, the
acknowledgment and reminder emails and the cancellation flow against automatic-renewal laws (ROSCA, California
Bus. & Prof. Code § 17600 et seq., New York GBL § 527-a and the other state laws), keeps signed evidence, and tells you
exactly what to change.

**Getting started (humans and AI agents):** call `createDeviceAuthorization` (the human approves once in a browser;
`createDeviceToken` then returns test keys), connect the remote MCP server at `https://app.checkbox.site/mcp` (tool
`setup_checkbox`), or create a test key in the dashboard, and call the API with `Authorization: Bearer ck_test_…`. Test keys act on an isolated sandbox and never
need activation. Live keys (`ck_live_…`) need an activated account: verify the domain of one of your sites.

**Conventions:** JSON in and out, snake_case, prefixed ids (`site_…`), unix-second timestamps, cursor pagination
(`limit`, `starting_after`, `ending_before`), `Idempotency-Key` on every POST, `Checkbox-Version` (date) header,
`expand[]`. Errors are `{ "error": { "type", "code", "message", "param", "doc_url", "request_id", "next_action" } }`;
`next_action` tells an agent what to call next. Webhooks are signed with `Checkbox-Signature: t=…,v1=…`
(HMAC-SHA256 of `"{t}.{raw body}"` with the endpoint secret).

Free to use: no plan limits on compliance features; fair-use limits apply (25 sites per account by default, per-key rate
limits). A compliance warranty for compliant merchants is coming (waitlist only; Checkbox does not provide insurance
coverage today).

tags.name: Agent setup
tags.description: One-call onboarding for AI coding agents: the setup_checkbox MCP tool (or the `checkbox init` CLI) signs the human in with one browser approval (device authorization), gets test-mode keys, and drives a setup session (snippet, site, Terms and policies, first checks, Stripe test subscription) until next_action is "done".

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The account behind the API key: mode, live-mode activation, limits and the next step.

tags.name: Sites
tags.description: The subscription businesses Checkbox monitors, how to install the snippet, and domain verification (which activates live mode).

tags.name: Scans
tags.description: Synthetic-shopper runs: Checkbox visits the checkout from each state and device, completes a sign-up when configured, receives the emails and tries to cancel online.

tags.name: Evaluations
tags.description: Compliance verdicts: score 0-100 and the insurable flag, with the checks that block insurability.

tags.name: Findings
tags.description: The latest result of each legal check for a site, with citations, evidence references and remediation.

tags.name: Compliance plans
tags.description: The agent-to-agent fix loop: an ordered, machine-readable plan of changes (requirement + citation, where, the exact patch / copy / Stripe params, how to verify), verification of each change, and questions for the human where a machine cannot decide.

tags.name: Fixes
tags.description: Engine-verified, platform-specific fixes for failing findings: Stripe Checkout code, Payment Link updates, Shopify blocks, snippet disclosures and the hosted cancellation page.

tags.name: Evidence
tags.description: The tamper-evident evidence vault behind every finding: screenshots, HTML, emails, platform configuration, evaluations.

tags.name: Certificates
tags.description: Signed monitoring certificates with a public verification page and trust badge. Not insurance.

tags.name: Notices
tags.description: The legally required acknowledgment, trial-ending, renewal, yearly-terms, price-change and cancellation emails, timed from the legal catalog: you send them and Checkbox tracks them (mode merchant, the default), or Checkbox sends them for you (mode checkbox).

tags.name: Law updates
tags.description: Changes in automatic-renewal law that Checkbox applies, with their effect on your sites. Subscribe to the law.changed webhook to hear about them.

tags.name: Checks
tags.description: Preflight compliance checks (“check before you ship”) of disclosure text, Stripe params, lifecycle emails and checkout HTML — stateless, for AI coding agents and CI.

tags.name: Elements
tags.description: Checkbox Elements: the drop-in <checkbox-disclosure> web component (and React wrapper) that shows the locked automatic-renewal disclosure above the pay button with an unchecked consent checkbox, and the consent records it creates.

tags.name: Receipts
tags.description: Consent receipts (opt-in per account): for each subscriber checkout where they are on, a tamper-evident record of the disclosure visibly rendered next to the pay button and the consent given — a structured snapshot of the disclosure (visible text, sanitized HTML, legally relevant styles, checkbox state, button label, layout), hashed, chained into the evidence vault, signed and re-rendered as an image on demand. For Stripe-hosted checkouts, reconstructed from Stripe's record. Evidence you can produce; not legal protection.

tags.name: Test runs
tags.description: Synthetic test subscriptions ("CMS preview" of your subscription lifecycle): Checkbox subscribes a test customer in your billing platform's TEST mode, receives your emails at its own inbox, fast-forwards a Stripe test clock through trial end and renewal, cancels online, and reports every step with evidence, check results and fixes. Nothing is charged.

tags.name: Webhook endpoints
tags.description: Endpoints that receive signed events. Verify Checkbox-Signature with the endpoint secret (HMAC-SHA256 of "{t}.{raw body}", 5-minute tolerance). Failed deliveries are retried with backoff for about three days.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Things that happened in the account (also delivered to webhook endpoints). Kept for 30 days.

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Report a problem or a missing feature to the Checkbox team.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Events Checkbox POSTs to your webhook endpoints.

post.description: Starts a synthetic test subscription in TEST mode and returns it queued. Stripe runs mirror your checkout into a test-mode Checkout Session, subscribe a test customer (card 4242) whose email is a Checkbox inbox, wait for your acknowledgment, advance a test clock through every legal notice window before trial end and renewal, cancel online in the customer portal and wait for the confirmation; then delete the test clock. Takes about 5-20 minutes: poll retrieveTestRun (next_action says when) or listen for test_run.completed. Each step reports observations, check results and agent-readable fixes; apply them and run again to verify.

insufficient_scope.description: The restricted key lacks the scope this endpoint needs.

insufficient_role.description: The key (or the person who created it) does not have a role that allows this action.

account_not_activated.description: Live mode needs an activated account: verify the domain of one of your sites (or use a test key).

domain_not_verified.description: Checkbox only scans, monitors, fetches and test-runs websites the account has verified (DNS TXT record or /.well-known file): every target host (site, checkout, account and policy URLs) must be on a verified domain. `next_action` says which domain to verify.
